Traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
Traits.text: When Avalla makes an attack, she has Advantage on the attack roll.

Traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
Traits.text: Advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and supernatural effects.

Actions.name: Lightning Lash
Actions.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) lightning; Avalla can move target up to 15 ft.

Actions.name: Iron Terror
Actions.text: 1/day; 4th-level spell. 30-foot cone; DC 15 Wisdom save. Fail: 21 (6d6) psychic and frightened of each High Command member for 1 minute (save ends end of turn).

BonusActions.name: Iron Shakles
BonusActions.text: 1/day; 3rd-level spell, Concentration. Animated iron chains fill a 15-foot square within 60 ft. for 1 minute. Entering/starting turn there: DC 15 Dex save or Restrained; save ends at start of next turn. Restrained creature takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning at end of each turn.

BonusActions.name: Iron Ring
BonusActions.text: 2/day. Teleport to/from the Cyst as described in the stat block.

Reactions.name: Escape Ring
Reactions.text: When Avalla isn't in the Cyst and an ally she can see within 60 ft. drops to 0 HP, teleport to the Cyst with each willing ally within 60 ft. who isn't incapacitated.

Reactions.name: Spellcasting Feedback
Reactions.text: When a creature within 60 ft. casts a spell, it taps into Avalla's mind. It can choose to take 1d6 psychic damage per spell level or let the spell fail; if it fails, the caster's spell slot is expended and action is wasted.

LegendaryActions.name: Promised Storm
LegendaryActions.text: Fires a lightning bolt at creature she can see within 90 ft. Bolt leaps from that target to up to 2 others within 30 ft of the first. DC 15 DEX save, taking 4d10 lightning damage on failed, or half on success.

Description: Battlefield controller and anti-caster. Stay protected behind Erasmus/Cloak. Use Iron Terror to disrupt formation; Spellcasting Feedback punishes the party for trying to answer her with magic. Iron Ring 2/day; Escape Ring triggers at 0 HP if available.
